name: PLUE
description: PLUE is a multi-task benchmark designed to evaluate natural language understanding of privacy policies in English across various tasks. It includes a large corpus of privacy policies to enable domain-specific language model pre-training, improving performance on privacy-related NLU tasks.
reputation: PLUE is a niche but useful benchmark in privacy-policy understanding, mainly cited within privacy/NLU research rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Includes domain-specific continual pre-training on a large corpus of privacy policies.
